title: 第七章　清洗与巩固，1935—1939

children: 我们［布尔什维克］不像其他人。我们是一个把不可能变为可能的党……如果党要求，如果这对党必要或重要，我们就能凭意志行为，在二十四小时内从头脑中驱逐我们多年持有的观念……是的，我会看到黑，尽管我原先以为、也许现在仍以为看到的是白——因为对我来说，党之外、或不同意党就没有生活。

We [Bolsheviks] are not like other people. We are a party of people who make the impossible possible…. And if the Party demands it, if it is necessary or important for the Party, we will be able by an act of will to expel from our brains in twenty-four hours ideas that we have held for years…. Yes, I will see black where I thought I saw white, or may still see it, because for me there is no life outside the Party or apart from agreement with it.
革命的幽灵正在困扰世界……你真以为我不会参与其中？你真以为在这场我们党将起决定作用的伟大世界性变革中，我会置身事外？

The specter of revolution is haunting the world…. And do you really think I’m not going to be part of it? Do you really think that in this great world-wide transformation, in which our Party will play the decisive role, I will remain on the sidelines?
我们生活在一个变得不真实而陌生的国度；十步之外，没人听得见我们的交谈。但每当有半句话交谈的机会出现，我们绝不会不提那位克里姆林宫的山民。
We exist in a land grown unreal and strange; Ten steps away no one hears the talk we exchange. But when chances for half-conversations appear, We will never omit the Kremlin mountaineer.
每一根粗手指都像一条养肥的虫子，在比划；他的话砸向你，仿佛有千钧之重。他那浓密的蟑螂式胡子透着善意的笑，而他靴子的长筒：永远一尘不染地发亮。

Each thick finger, a fattened worm, gesticulates And his words strike you like they were many-pound weights His full cockroach mustache hints a laughter benigning, And the shafts of his boots: always spotlessly shining.
〔译注〕本书署年为1934年；有关曼德尔施塔姆的研究通常将此诗写作时间记为1933年。
〔译注〕本书署年为1934年；有关曼德尔施塔姆的研究通常将此诗写作时间记为1933年。

zh: 1930年代前半期，斯大林在旧俄国的躯体上挖了一个巨大的“基坑”（用安德烈·普拉东诺夫的说法），并在其中埋下成熟苏维埃制度的粗糙物质基础。而在这个十年的后半期，他又通过清洗这场新的阶级斗争，锻造出使制度得以运转所必需的价值和文化上层建筑。的确，他试图塑造一种特殊的人——“苏维埃新人”（
）——以适合党所建立的新文明。于是，在三十年代所有阵痛结束时，苏维埃制度终于将实现其极权主义的最大潜能。
en: In the first half of the 1930s Stalin had dug a great “foundation pit” (in Andrei Platonov’s phrase) in the body of old Russia, and in it he implanted the rude material base of the mature Soviet system. And now in the second half of the decade, through the new class struggle of the purges, he forged that superstructure of values and culture indispensable for making the system function. Indeed, he sought to fashion a special breed of man—a “new Soviet man,”
—appropriate to the new civilization the Party had built. And so at the end of all the travails of the thirties, the Soviet system at last would come to realize its maximum totalitarian potential.

zh: 这一巩固过程的核心，当然是清洗，即1936—1939年的大恐怖。此后，这一事件在民族意识中始终是斯大林主义罪行的顶峰，也是斯大林主义最离奇的功业。它尤其被苏联精英——其主要受害者——记为一段令人极度恐惧的时期。如同集体化和古拉格的情况，清洗的真实性质和全部规模在当时大多被掩盖。然而，揭开清洗秘密的努力，将成为日后全面揭露斯大林主义成就的突破口。
en: The centerpiece of this process of consolidation was of course the purge, or the Great Terror of 1936-1939. This episode remained ever after in the national consciousness as the peak of Stalinist crime and the most fantastic of Stalinist exploits. It was remembered in particular by the Soviet elites, its principal victims, as a time of mythic dread. As was the case with collectivization and the Gulag, the real nature and the full extent of the purges were largely concealed at the time. Yet the effort to pierce the secret of the purges would become the entering wedge for the future unmasking of the Stalinist achievement as a whole.

zh: 因此，在关于苏维埃主义的争论中，对清洗的解释以一种新的、更尖锐的方式聚焦了那些熟悉的问题。对于大多数评论者来说，共产主义的大分界线在列宁主义与斯大林主义之间；对他们而言，强制集体化当然是分水岭事件；然而，正是大恐怖才最终确立了多数人的论点，因为只有到那时，斯大林才转而反对布尔什维克主义本身，摧毁了列宁的党。的确，对于那些坚信列宁革命美德的人来说，“好共产党人”遭到清洗，算得上比消灭富农更严重的罪行；因此，1937年受到的关注明显多于去富农化。
en: Thus in the debate over Sovietism, interpretation of the purges focuses familiar problems in a new and sharper way. To that majority of commentators for whom the great divide in Communism runs between Leninism and Stalinism, forced collectivization is of course the watershed event; nonetheless, it is the Great Terror that clinches the majority’s case, because it was only then that Stalin turned against Bolshevism itself and destroyed the Party of Lenin. Indeed, for those committed to the virtue of Lenin’s Revolution, the purge of “good Communists” counts as a rather worse crime than the extermination of the kulaks; hence, 1937 has received distinctly more attention than has dekulakization.

zh: 因此，清洗是苏联史“坏人论”和“畸变论”的症结所在，因为它们似乎把这种畸变的责任直接归咎于斯大林的性格。如果说有哪个事例能证明斯大林权力欲或疯狂、或二者兼有起了决定作用，那就是这件事。而如果能为如此关键的事件提出这样的论证，那么它就会波及斯大林其余的全部施政记录，并实际上把他从苏维埃社会主义的正典中剔除。另一方面，如果能证明斯大林1936年以后的行动在共产主义制度内具有政治功能，那么他在真正苏维埃主义逻辑中的位置就是稳固的，而我们戏剧中的“坏人”就是制度本身。因为到1939年，他的制度建设事业已经完成，其基本要素将一直保留到1989—1991年的大崩溃。
en: Thus the purges are the crux of the “bad man” and the “aberration” theories of Soviet history, for they seem to place the blame for this aberration squarely on Stalin’s character. If ever there was a case for the decisive role of Stalin’s lust for power or his insanity or both, this is it. And if such a case can be made for so crucial an episode, then it rubs off on all the rest of Stalin’s record and effectively removes him from the canon of Soviet socialism. On the other hand, if Stalin’s actions after 1936 can be shown to be politically functional within the Communist system, then his place in the logic of real Sovietism is secure and the system itself is the “bad man” of our drama. For by 1939 his work of system-building had been completed, and its essentials would remain in place until the grand collapse of 1989-1991.

zh: 但清洗还可以支撑另一种解释：它可被视为斯大林主义内部的一道大分界，一边是早期建设社会主义的建设性岁月，另一边是后来毁灭性地大批消灭党员的时期。
在这种视角下，斯大林工作的主要部分是真正社会主义的、进步的，只有次要的部分，即“个人崇拜”，必须从正典中切除。这是赫鲁晓夫1956年“秘密报告”提出的观点。
这也仍然是戈尔巴乔夫1987年革命七十周年时提出的视角。的确，评价斯大林的施政记录时采取类似的选择性，在西方史学中很常见，尤其是在那些认为“布哈林替代方案”的拥护者放弃了太多苏联成就的人中间。
en: But the purges can serve to found still another interpretation: they may be seen as a great divide within Stalinism, between the early, constructive years of building socialism and the later, destructive period of decimating the Party.

In this perspective the major part of Stalin’s work is authentically socialist and progressive, and only the lesser part, the “cult,” must be excised from the canon. This was the view that Khrushchev put forth in his “secret speech” in 1956.

And this was still the perspective put forth by Gorbachev for the seventieth anniversary of the Revolution in 1987. Indeed, a similar selectiveness in evaluating Stalin’s record has been common in Western historiography, in particular among those who believed that the partisans of the “Bukharin alternative” surrendered too much of the Soviet achievement.

zh: 在苏维埃政权存在期间，这种平衡术是必要的。制度的基坑确实是在斯大林掌权的最初几年挖下的，因此，如果苏维埃社会主义要被改革而不是被取代，就不能把它算作犯罪。然而，随着政权的崩溃，相信斯大林主义有一个创造性阶段的动机按逻辑现在应当消失。但我们不应指望这样的结果，因为只要人们还相信完整社会主义的工具性纲领——即终结私有财产，而这在历史上第一次是在斯大林治下实现的——挽救斯大林主义某些东西的需要就会持续存在。
en: This balancing act was necessary while the Soviet regime existed. The foundation pit of the system had indeed been dug during Stalin’s first years in power and therefore could not be accounted criminal if Soviet socialism were to be reformed rather than replaced. With the regime’s collapse, however, the motivation to believe in a creative phase of Stalinism by all logic should now disappear. But we should not count on such an outcome, for the need to salvage something of Stalinism will endure so long as belief exists in the instrumental program of integral socialism—namely, the end of private property, which was achieved for the first time in history under Stalin.

zh: 然而，如果说清洗是成熟苏维埃主义巩固过程的核心，它绝不是这一过程的全部。在同一时期，一切文化活动都被置于党国的直接控制之下，从属于政权的政治命令。于是，1929年开始的“文化战线”上扫除文盲的斗争，最终导致思想和艺术的国家化或“国有化”，从而把制度的总体化逻辑推向极致。
只有在这种新文化的语境中，清洗才能得到充分理解。事实上，文化变革先于清洗，并为清洗铺平了道路，而清洗把“苏维埃新人”带上了舞台。
en: Yet if the purges were the centerpiece in the consolidation of mature Sovietism, they were by no means the whole process. During the same period, all cultural activity was brought under the direct control of the Party-state and subordinated to the political commands of the regime. Thus the struggle on the “cultural front” against illiteracy that began in 1929 culminated in the nationalization, or “state-ization,” of thought and art, thereby carrying the totalizing logic of the system to its final extreme.

It is only in the context of this new culture that the purges can be adequately understood. In fact, the cultural change preceded, and prepared the way for, the purge that brought the “new Soviet man” onto the scene.

zh: 苏维埃文化
en: SOVIET CULTURE

zh: 苏维埃文化的政治化早在斯大林之前就开始了，事实上也不是由党主动发起的。从1917年开始，一直延续到内战，在远比党广泛的圈子里，涌现出大量乌托邦和千禧年期待。这一运动从知识界的唯美主义者——如诗人亚历山大·布洛克，他把革命视为基督及其使徒话语的尘世实现；以及弗拉基米尔·马雅可夫斯基，他把革命视为未来主义文明的降临——一直到普通工人甚至农民，他们把革命视为自己人性和创造潜能的解放。民粹主义形式千禧年主义最重要的表现，是“无产阶级文化”组织，通称“无产阶级文化派”（Proletkult）。
其指导原则是一个貌似马克思主义的观念：无产阶级国家应当有无产阶级文化，一种与资产阶级前身截然不同的文化。无产阶级文化派的使命是鼓励工人从自身经验中创造这种新文化。到1920年，无产阶级文化派约有七十万成员，比党还多一点。列宁只能把这个组织视为竞争对手，因为它的大众吸引力和主观主义意识形态意味着，无产阶级的自发性不需要党的意识来引导。因此，在内战结束时，他使它从属于党，从而把它作为一个运动扼杀了。
en: The politicization of Soviet culture started well before Stalin and indeed without any Party initiative. Beginning in 1917 and continuing through the Civil War, there was a great outpouring of Utopian and millenarian expectation in circles far wider than the Party. This movement ranged from intellectual aesthetes such as the poets Aleksandr Blok, who saw the Revolution as the earthly realization of the word of Christ and his Apostles, and Vladimir Mayakovskii, who saw it as the advent of futurist civilization, to simple workers and even peasants, who saw it as a liberation of their humanity and creative potential. The most important manifestation of the populist form of millenarianism was the organization “Proletarskaia kultura,” or “Proletarian Culture,” commonly known as Proletkult.

Its guiding principle was the plausibly Marxist idea that a proletarian state should have a proletarian culture, one that was radically distinct from its bourgeois predecessor. The mission of Proletkult was to encourage workers to produce this new culture out of their own experience. By 1920 Proletkult had some seven hundred thousand members, or a bit more than the Party. Lenin could only view this organization as a rival, since its mass appeal and subjectivist ideology implied that proletarian spontaneity did not need to be guided by Party consciousness. At the end of the Civil War, therefore, he subordinated it to the Party and thus killed it as a movement.

zh: 直到新经济政策时期，党本身才转向社会主义国家中的文化问题。所有布尔什维克领袖都同意——而且作为马克思主义者，他们不得不同意——新社会最终将需要一种新文化。但他们中的大多数人也觉得，这一结果不能像无产阶级文化派试图做的那样人为制造，而会随着社会的变化自然出现；在此期间，社会需要向资产阶级文化学习。
en: It was only during the NEP that the Party itself turned to the problem of culture in a socialist state. All the Bolshevik leaders were—and indeed, as Marxists, had to be—in agreement that eventually the new society would require a new culture. Yet most of them also felt that this result could not be artificially produced, as Proletkult had tried to do, but would emerge naturally as society changed; in the meantime, society needed to go to the school of bourgeois culture.

zh: 如我们所见，正是这种态度导致了二十年代相对的文化活力。因此，非无产阶级的作家和艺术家，只要不敌视革命，就被允许作为“同路人”——托洛茨基的著名说法——发挥作用，就像其他资产阶级专家被容忍一样。同样，教育中也允许现代主义实验，例如采纳约翰·杜威的理论。更一般地说，二十年代是一个对未来集体主义和技术完美的人类状况进行乌托邦思考的时期。政权没有采取措施阻止这些“革命之梦”，
尽管它们并不直接符合党的路线，因为它们创造了一种有利于激进社会变革的氛围。艺术中没有正式的党的路线，托洛茨基和布哈林都积极捍卫这种局面（而斯大林则一言不发）。简言之，存在一个文化上的新经济政策，其形式是一个范围狭窄、受到限制的观念市场。
en: It is this attitude, as we have seen, that led to the relative cultural vitality of the twenties. Nonproletarian writers and artists, provided they were not hostile to the Revolution, were therefore allowed to function as “fellow travellers,” in Trotsky’s famous phrase, in the same way that other bourgeois specialists were tolerated. Similarly, modernist experimentation was permitted in education, for example, with the appropriation of the theories of John Dewey. More generally, the twenties were a period of Utopian thinking about the future collectivist and technologically perfect human condition. The regime did nothing to discourage these “revolutionary dreams,”

even though they were not directly in the Party line, because they created an atmosphere favorable to radical social transformation. There was no formal Party line in the arts, and both Trotsky and Bukharin actively defended this situation (while Stalin simply said nothing). In short, there existed a cultural NEP in the form of a circumscribed and truncated marketplace of ideas.

zh: 与斯大林治下的情况相比，这个文化新经济政策显然是苏联知识生活最具创造性的时期。然而，与旧制度下的情况相比，它同样明显地标志着一种倒退：它本身具有两面性，同时也包含着将摧毁它自身的斯大林主义文化的种子。
en: Compared to the situation under Stalin, this cultural NEP was clearly the most creative period of Soviet intellectual life. Compared to the situation under the Old Regime, however, it just as clearly marked a regression: It was ambiguous in its very nature, and at the same time it contained the seeds of the Stalinist culture that would destroy it.

zh: 我们已经看到这个斯大林主义前奏的一个方面：宣传国家的诞生及其“话语专制”习语在二十年代的形成。同样重要的是这一时期的新文化机构，以及知识生活关键领域的意识形态化。因为文化新经济政策如同经济领域的新经济政策一样，处在党掌握的“制高点”的阴影之下。
en: We have seen one aspect of this Stalinist prelude with the birth of the propaganda state and the creation of its logocratic idiom in the course of the twenties. Just as important were the new cultural institutions of the period and the ideologization of the key areas of intellectual life. For the cultural NEP, like its economic counterpart, lived in the shadow of the Party’s commanding heights.

zh: 成立了红色学院，以与官方科学院竞争；成立了红色教授学院，以培养干部接管“资产阶级”大学。布哈林积极支持这两个事业。资产阶级哲学遭到禁止，其一些主要代表人物被流放，辩证唯物主义成为唯一被允许的学派。资产阶级法学也被禁止，俄国法律界——1917年前俄国自由主义的主要基础之一——被瓦解。经济学也基本变成马克思主义的，这在关于计划的辩论中很明显——不过在这个例子中，结果并不是倒退，因为制约俄国发展的特殊环境为创新思维提供了刺激。历史学虽然没有直接受党控制，事实上却由米哈伊尔·波克罗夫斯基的马克思主义学派主导。另一方面，自然科学大体上未受干涉，因为它们没有提供与政权进行意识形态竞争的可能。
en: A Red Academy was created to compete against the official Academy of Sciences, and an Institute of Red Professors was formed to train cadres to take over the “bourgeois” university. Bukharin actively supported both of these enterprises. Bourgeois philosophy was abolished, some of its leading practitioners were exiled, and dialectical materialism became the only permitted school. Bourgeois law was also proscribed, and the Russian legal profession, one of the main bases of Russian liberalism before 1917, was dismantled. Economics also became basically Marxist, as was evident in the debates over the Plan—though in this instance the result was not a regression, since the exceptional circumstances governing Russian development provided a stimulus for innovative thinking. History, although not directly subjected to Party control, was in fact dominated by the Marxist school of Mikhail Pokrovskii. On the other hand, the natural sciences were largely left alone, since they did not offer a potential for ideological competition with the regime.

zh: 然而在1930年之前，意识形态战线上的这种动员很少直接由国家控制。它毋宁是自任使命的马克思主义团体所做的工作，这些团体的使命是在某一个领域取代资产阶级文化。这一现象的伟大原型，当然是无产阶级文化派。
en: Before 1930, however, very little of this mobilization on the ideological front was directly controlled by the state. It was the work, rather, of self-appointed Marxist groups with a mission to supplant bourgeois culture in one or another field. The great prototype of this phenomenon, of course, was Proletkult.

zh: 在大学里，二十年代的波克罗夫斯基“学派”也是一项类似的事业。
波克罗夫斯基是一位受过专业训练的历史学家，与米留可夫一样，是伟大的瓦西里·克柳切夫斯基的学生。他也是一位坚定的马克思主义者，把俄国历史解释为生产资料的演变和阶级斗争的机械产物。尽管他真正重视文献，但他和其学派仍然相信，只有他们的方法揭示了真理；结果，大学里不接受这种方法的资产阶级历史学家被解除职位。于是一个临时形成的意识形态狂热者团体围绕一套思想正统建立了垄断。
en: In the universities, the Pokrovskii “school” of the twenties was a similar endeavor.

Pokrovskii was a professionally trained historian, a pupil, along with Miliukov, of the great Vasilii Kliuchevskii. He was also a convinced Marxist who explained Russian history as the mechanistic product of the evolution of the means of production and the class struggle. Although he had a genuine concern for documentation, he and his school nonetheless believed that their approach alone revealed the truth; in consequence, bourgeois historians in the universities who would not accept this approach were removed from their positions. Thus an ad hoc group of ideological zealots established a monopoly around an intellectual orthodoxy.

zh: 哲学中也发生了类似的过程。这里的领袖是阿布拉姆·德波林，另一位受过专业训练的学者，具有真正的马克思主义信念。二十年代，苏联哲学中的重大问题是“机械论者”与“辩证论者”之间的斗争，德波林是后者的领袖。“机械论者”认为，科学世界观只是所有具体科学的总和，因此力求把哲学排除在科学实践之外；而“辩证论者”遵循恩格斯和普列汉诺夫的形而上学路线，希望表明辩证法是涵盖社会和自然的普遍科学。到二十年代末，德波林及其盟友已经获胜，并在哲学中确立了他们的思想和人事霸权。
en: A similar process occurred in philosophy. Here the leader was Abram Deborin, another professionally trained academic with genuine Marxist convictions. In the twenties, the great issue in Soviet philosophy was the struggle between the “mechanists” and the “dialecticians,” and Deborin was the leader of the second group. The “mechanists” held that the scientific worldview was merely the sum total of all the concrete sciences and therefore sought to keep philosophy out of the practice of science, whereas the “dialecticians,” following the metaphysical tack of Engels and Plekhanov, wished to show that dialectics was a universal science embracing both society and nature. By the end of the decade Deborin and his allies had won and established their intellectual and personal hegemony in philosophy.

zh: 但意识形态领域的自发整肃最显著的例子，也许是俄罗斯无产阶级作家协会（RAPP），它成立于1928年，由文学批评家列奥波德·阿维尔巴赫领导。

拉普以更教条的方式发展早期战斗左翼主义的种子，其纲领是文学应当服从明确的“社会命令”。由此推论，文学也必须由无产者、至少由马克思主义者主导；而事实上，拉普的成员是党的积极分子，不是工人。因此，资产阶级同路人应当被推开，新的“无产阶级”作家应当取代他们的领导地位并获得相应待遇。拉普出现在沙赫特审判和第一个五年计划启动之际；因此，以阶级斗争精神庆祝计划，成为其活动的焦点。作为时代变化的标志，这一运动产生的从众压力促成了马雅可夫斯基1930年的自杀。
en: But perhaps the most notable example of ideological vigilantism was that of the Russian Association of Proletarian Writers, or RAPP, which was founded in 1928 and led by the literary critic Leopold Averbakh.

Developing in more doctrinaire fashion earlier seeds of militant leftism, RAPP’s program was that literature should obey an explicit “social command.” It thus followed that literature must also be dominated by proletarians, or at least by Marxists, and in fact the members of RAPP were Party activists, not workers. Consequently, bourgeois fellow travellers should be shoved aside, and the new “proletarian” writers should inherit their leadership and rewards. RAPP came on the scene at the time of the Shakhty trial and the launching of the First Five-Year Plan; celebration of the Plan in the spirit of class war, therefore, became the focus of its activities. As a sign of changing times, the conformist pressure this drive generated contributed to Maiakovskii’s suicide in 1930.

zh: 波克罗夫斯基、德波林和阿维尔巴赫的共同努力，是1928年至1931年第一个五年计划启动期间战斗性左翼思潮的普遍运动的一部分，尤其在共青团员和突击工人中间。这一运动有时被称为文化革命（仿佛它是苏联对毛主义的一种预示）。
但基本上，它被呈现为斯大林大攻势的源头——这种进路会使他的第一个五年计划成为一场自下而上的革命，至少在开始时如此，而不是自上而下的革命。简言之，把文化革命理解为苏联历史上一个独特时期的观念，是解决斯大林问题的又一种方式：它使他的攻势显得起源于民主，因而是一项真正社会主义的成就。
en: The conjoined efforts of Pokrovskii, Deborin, and Averbakh were part of a general movement of militant leftism, especially among Komsomols and shock workers, during the launching of the First Five-Year Plan between 1928 and 1931. This movement has sometimes been called the Cultural Revolution (as if it were a kind of Soviet anticipation of Maoism).

But basically it has been presented as if it were the source of Stalin’s Great Offensive—an approach that would make his First Five-Year Plan a revolution from below, at least at the start, rather than from above. In short, the idea of Cultural Revolution, understood as a distinct period of Soviet history, is still another way to solve the Stalin problem: It makes his Offensive appear to be democratic in origin, and hence a genuinely socialist achievement.

zh: 但1928—1931年的左翼浪潮远非如此简单。自1918年布哈林的左翼共产主义和无产阶级文化派兴起以来，战斗左翼主义一直是苏联生活的常见现象。新经济政策的鼎盛抑制了它的表达，但1928年计划筹备工作，加上党的扩张和思想灌输的加强，重新点燃了仍然活着的余烬。的确，在沙赫特事件开始时，在国家政治保卫局（GPU，契卡的继承机构）接管之前，工人对资产阶级出身的工程师确实存在怀疑。随后，斯大林和领导层在1928—1931年间刺激这些激进能量，用于进攻农民和推动工业化。因此，尽管攻势绝不是左翼浪潮的产物，它首先刺激了这一浪潮，然后为自己的目的加以利用。但左翼主义一旦失控，就立即受到以“胜利冲昏头脑”为样板的警告性谴责的约束。苏联左翼主义的最后喘息，也许是斯达汉诺夫运动的初期阶段；此后，一切来自下层的热情都由来自上层的行动加以引导。
en: But the leftist surge of 1928-1931 is hardly so simple. Militant leftism had been endemic to Soviet life since the Left Communism of Bukharin and the beginnings of Proletkult in 1918. The high NEP had put a damper on its expression, but the buildup to the Plan in 1928, together with the expansion of the Party and the growth of indoctrination, rekindled the still-live embers. Indeed, at the beginning of the Shakhty affair, before the GPU (the successor to the Cheka) took it over, there was genuine worker suspicion of engineers of bourgeois origin. Stalin and the leadership then stimulated these radical energies during 1928-1931 for the assault on the peasantry and the drive for industrialization. Thus, though the Offensive was in no sense produced by a surge of leftism, it first stimulated and then utilized this surge for its own purposes. But when leftism got out of hand, it was immediately reined in with a monitory denunciation on the model of “dizziness from success.” Perhaps the last gasp of Soviet leftism was the initial phase of the Stakhanovite movement; henceforth, all enthusiasm from below was channeled by action from above.

zh: 文化战线上也发生了对战斗左翼主义的类似驯服和“国家化”，这一过程始于计划的实施。文化此时也被纳入总路线，很快也受到中央计划的支配。1930年至1932年间，刚才讨论的每一个敏感领域都被政权吞并，直接服从于其当下的政治目的。而在每一个例子中，都是斯大林亲自发起变革。然而，他一次也不是出于个人任性；贯穿三十年代所有文化变革的，有一种模式，确切地说，有一种逻辑。
en: A similar taming and “statization” of militant leftism occurred on the cultural front, and this process began with the implementation of the Plan. Culture, too, was now absorbed into the General Line and soon was centrally planned. Between 1930 and 1932 each of the sensitive fields just discussed was annexed by the regime and directly subordinated to its immediate political purposes. And in each case Stalin personally initiated the change. Yet in no instance was he acting out of personal caprice; there is a pattern, indeed a logic, running through all the cultural changes of the thirties.

zh: 第一个被“国有化”的领域是哲学，仿佛是在向马克思关于无产阶级是这门科学的积极实践主体的理论致敬。

1930年12月，在工业化危机的高峰，斯大林接见红色教授学院的党组织执行委员会，谴责德波林主义是“孟什维化的唯心主义”。执行委员会随后通过决议，谴责这种唯心主义是半托洛茨基主义，并谴责“机械论”是右倾的意识形态基础。这一深奥策略的第一个结果是，现在存在一种唯一的辩证唯物主义正统，它与孟什维克普列汉诺夫无关，而与马克思、恩格斯和列宁相关——当然，在新领袖干预之后，也与斯大林相关。世界社会主义四位伟人的新使徒传承由此建立。第二个结果是，这种新正统及其真先知传承，可以被用来衡量政治偏离，以便谴责它们。此后，这种偏离不再被当作共产主义内部的意见分歧，而是被当作非马克思主义、因而反苏和叛国运动，只配被摧毁。第三个结果是，有雄心的年轻哲学家现在有了一个得到官方认可的标准，可以用来谴责德波林派并接管他们的学术职位。最后一个结果是，党国有了严格的思想标准来判断其人员的忠诚。
en: The first field to be “nationalized” was philosophy, as if in homage to Marx’s theory of the proletariat as the active agent of that science.

In December 1930, at the height of the crisis of industrialization, Stalin gave an interview to the Party executive of the Institute of Red Professors in which he denounced Deborinism as “Menshevising idealism.” The executive then passed a resolution condemning this idealism as semi-Trotskyism and denouncing “mechanism” as the ideological basis of the Right deviation. The first result of this abstruse maneuver was that there now existed a single orthodoxy of dialectical materialism that was associated not with the Menshevik Plekhanov but with Marx, Engels, and Lenin—and, of course, with Stalin after the new Leader’s intervention. A new apostolic succession of the four great figures of world socialism was thereby established. A second result was that this new orthodoxy, and the succession of its true prophets, could be used to measure political deviations with the intent of condemning them. Henceforth such deviations were not to be treated as disagreements within Communism, but as non-Marxist and hence anti-Soviet and traitorous movements fit only to be destroyed. A third result was that ambitious younger philosophers now had an authorized standard by which to condemn the Deborinites and take over their academic positions. And a final result was that the Party-state had a rigorous ideological criterion for determining the loyalty of its personnel.

zh: 尽管如此，德波林主义并没有完全消亡。它粗糙的辩证唯物主义只是被弄得更加粗糙，并以问答形式标准化；以这种经过重新包装的形态，尤其是斯大林本人在1938年《简明教程》著名的一章中重复它之后，它将一直存续到苏维埃政权的终结。于是，德波林和其他战斗左翼分子在二十年代末的命运，就是提供摧毁自己的意识形态武器，并为正在形成的斯大林主义文化提供基本成分。
en: Nonetheless, Deborinism did not perish utterly. Its crude dialectical materialism was simply made cruder and standardized in catechetical form; and in this recycled guise, especially as Stalin himself repeated it in a famous chapter of his

of 1938, it would live on until the end of the Soviet regime. Thus the lot of Deborin and of other militant leftists at the end of the twenties was to furnish the ideological weapons for their own undoing, and to supply the basic ingredients of the emerging Stalinist culture.

zh: 历史学这门学科次年也遭遇了同样的命运，时在1931年。这一次，转向是在斯大林致《无产阶级革命》杂志编辑的一封信中宣布的，涉及党史。该杂志刊登了一篇分析列宁在处理第二国际问题时某些错误的文章。斯大林回复说，列宁从未犯过错误，从而立下一条规则：对党史、列宁在其中的作用，以及隐含地对他——斯大林——作为列宁继承人的地位，只有一种正确看法。新正统逐渐成为：列宁及其党一直正确；斯大林是列宁建党和领导十月革命的最亲密合作者；斯大林现在正通过建设社会主义来完成那场革命。同样，托洛茨基主义和其他偏离根本不是党史的一部分，而是与孟什维主义以及列宁早先与之斗争的一切其他形式的社会民主主义类似的异己的敌对表现。
en: The same fate befell the discipline of history the following year, in 1931. This time the turn was announced in a letter of Stalin to the editors of the journal

and concerned Party history. The journal had printed an article analyzing certain mistakes of Lenin in dealing with the Second International. Stalin replied that Lenin had never made mistakes, thereby laying down the rule that there was a single correct view of Party history, of Lenin’s role in it, and, by implication, of his—Stalin’s-position as Lenin’s successor. The new orthodoxy came to be that Lenin and his Party had always been right; that Stalin had been Lenin’s closest collaborator in building the Party and in leading the October Revolution; and that Stalin was now completing that Revolution by building socialism. By the same token, Trotskyism and other deviations were not a part of Party history at all but alien enemy manifestations similar to Menshevism and all the other forms of Social Democracy that Lenin had combatted earlier.

zh: 驯服历史的下一步，是把党史与革命前的俄国历史结合起来，这意味着取缔波克罗夫斯基学派。波克罗夫斯基曾以完全负面但相当马克思主义的术语，把旧制度下的俄国国家说成是统治阶级剥削俄国人民的工具。他在俄国过去没有留下任何正面英雄或光荣事迹。然而到1934年，随着新秩序接近完成，领导层开始把这种对民族过去的贬低视为会挫伤新国家公民的士气。之所以如此，是因为俄国的光荣在于创造了世界上第一个社会主义社会；也就是说，旧制度不应被视为俄国的过去，而应被视为一个全新实体——苏联——的过去。波克罗夫斯基的观点因此被谴责为“抽象社会学图式”，党号召提供具体的名字、日期和事件，使俄国历史教学对新的群众教育体系中的学生更加生动。特别是，新历史要强调中央集权俄国国家的建立是一个进步发展；因此，彼得大帝和伊凡雷帝由于他们是强有力的国家建设者，便成了英雄。
en: The next step in the taming of history was to combine Party and prerevolutionary Russian history, and this meant the elimination of the Pokrovskii school. Pokrovskii had presented the old-regime Russian state in completely negative but quite Marxist terms as the agent of the ruling classes in exploiting the Russian people. He left no positive heroes or glorious deeds in Russia’s past. By 1934, however, as the new order was nearing completion, such disparagement of the national past came to be viewed by the leadership as demoralizing to the citizens of the new state. This was so because the glory of Russia was to have created the world’s first socialist society; that is, the Old Regime was to be viewed not as a Russian past but as the past of a radically new entity, the Soviet Union. Pokrovskii’s views were accordingly denounced as “abstract sociological schemes,” and the Party called for concrete names, dates, and events to make the teaching of Russian history more vivid for students in the new mass system of education. In particular, the new history was to emphasize the creation of a centralized Russian state as a progressive development; Peter the Great and Ivan the Terrible, therefore, became heroes insofar as they had been mighty state-builders.

zh: 这种对俄国历史的部分重新评价，与重新引入军衔标志、学校中的制服和纪律，以及在离婚和堕胎等事项立法中恢复传统家庭价值观，恰好同时发生。所有这些合在一起，有时被视为对革命乌托邦主义的“大退却”和向俄国民族主义的回归。
因此，有人把它视为斯大林背叛革命和社会主义国际主义的又一个方面。简言之，这些变化与新经济政策，是被视为苏联“热月”的两种候选事件，即真正革命的终结。
en: This partial rehabilitation of the Russian past coincided with the reintroduction of insignia for military rank, of uniforms and discipline in the schools, and of traditional family values in legislation regarding such matters as divorce and abortion. All of this taken together has sometimes been regarded as a “great retreat” from revolutionary utopianism and a return to Russian nationalism.”

As such, it has been seen by some as still another aspect of Stalin’s betrayal of the Revolution and of socialist internationalism. In short, together with the NEP, these changes are one of the two candidates for the role of Soviet “Thermidor,” that is, the end of the true Revolution.

zh: 然而事实上，从来就没有过苏联热月；俄国雅各宾派永久掌权。此外，用民族主义一词来描述推翻波克罗夫斯基、更广泛地说大退却所涉及的事情，非常容易造成误解。俄国民族象征的平反既是高度选择性的，也完全从属于苏联目的。得到平反的只是建设中央集权国家中的强有力领导；而这确实是传统俄国民族主义的一个组成部分。但俄国民族情感的另外两项主要内容——东正教和农民俄国的文化特殊性——仍被禁止。而且，旧俄国国家被说成只不过是崭新而不同的苏维埃国家的前身，而后者是一个社会主义的多民族党国。此外，旧制度下的革命运动继续被强调为比专制制度更进步的力量，因为它最终产生了列宁和十月。这个“社会运动”，比伊凡和彼得更能代表俄国真正的民族成就：它证明了俄国在革命事务上优于西方，从而使俄国成为全人类进步事业的领导者。事实上，1934年宣布的官方公式最好地概括了这种局面：所有“加盟”苏维埃共和国都是“民族形式、社会主义内容”。
en: In fact, however, there never was a Soviet Thermidor; the Russian Jacobins remained in power permanently. Moreover, nationalism is a very misleading term for what was involved in the overthrow of Pokrovskii and, more broadly, in the great retreat. The rehabilitation of Russian national symbols was both highly selective and wholly subordinated to Soviet purposes. All that was rehabilitated was forceful leadership in the building of a centralized state; and this had indeed been a component of traditional Russian nationalism. But the other two staples of Russian national sentiment, Orthodoxy and the cultural specificity of peasant Russia, remained proscribed. Moreover, the old Russian state was presented as no more than a precursor of the very new and different Soviet state, which was a socialist and multinational Party-state. In addition, the revolutionary movement under the Old Regime continued to be emphasized as an even more progressive force than the autocracy, since it eventually produced Lenin and October. This “social movement,” more than Ivan and Peter, was indeed the true national accomplishment of Russia: It demonstrated Russia’s superiority to the West in matters revolutionary, and thereby made her the progressive leader of all mankind. This situation is in fact best characterized by the official formula proclaimed in 1934: All the “constituent” Soviet republics were “national in form and socialist in content.”

zh: 政权在波克罗夫斯基之后的史学中所寻求的，是一种苏维埃爱国主义，它将颂扬新的社会主义秩序，并在新近受教育的工人人口中激发自豪和忠诚。一种特定的俄国民族主义只是这种爱国主义的一个组成部分。事实上，发生的是对俄国民族情感的吞并和利用，以便为苏联那个仍然人为而脆弱的社会主义混合物增添力量。简言之，三十年代中期出现的是“一国社会主义”的国家爱国主义。斯大林是非俄国人，因此可能个人倾向于通过强调俄国性来补偿，这一事实也许促进了这一发展。但这种爱国主义的主要动机，是需要向人民解释并证明一个未曾预料的事实：中央集权国家的建立竟是伟大社会主义攻势的主要结果之一。
en: What the regime sought in post-Pokrovksii historiography was a Soviet patriotism that would glorify the new socialist order and inspire pride and loyalty in the freshly educated worker population. A specifically Russian nationalism was only one component of this patriotism. In fact, what occurred was an annexation and exploitation of Russian national sentiment in order to lend strength to the Soviet Union’s still artificial and fragile Soviet socialist amalgam. In short, what emerged in the mid-thirties was the state patriotism of socialism in one country. The fact that Stalin was a non-Russian and therefore may have been personally inclined to emphasize Russianness by way of compensation probably facilitated this development. But the principal motive for this patriotism was the need to justify to the population the unanticipated fact that the creation of a centralized state had been among the chief results of the Great Socialist Offensive.

zh: 此外，新的史学同波克罗夫斯基的史学一样，仍建立在历史唯物主义之上。尽管它重新强调十月革命前革命运动中的英雄人物，偶尔也强调某位专制君主，苏联的历史写作仍继续依托基础与上层建筑加阶级斗争这一陈旧的社会学模型，只是此时这一模型变得更加粗糙、更加机械。因此，波克罗夫斯基的基本进路同德波林的辩证唯物主义一样，在新的斯大林主义文化中存活了下来。所有这些的顶点，是1938年斯大林《联共（布）党史简明教程》的出版——通称《简明教程》——它当年是二十世纪最畅销的著作之一，不仅在俄国，而且在全世界。
en: Moreover, the new historiography, like Pokrovskii’s, was founded on historical materialism. Although it gave new emphasis to the heroes of the pre-October revolutionary movement and to an occasional autocrat, Soviet historical writing continued to rest on the old sociological model of the base and the superstructure in conjunction with the class struggle, but this model was now made still cruder and more mechanistic. So Pokrovskii’s basic approach, like Deborin’s dialectical materialism, lived on in the new Stalinist culture. The culmination of all this came in 1938 with the publication of Stalin’s

children: History of the All-Union Communist Party (Bolsheviks)

en: —better known as the
—in its day one of the great best-sellers of the twentieth century, not just in Russia but around the world.

zh: 这一文献把整个新的苏维埃文化整合了起来。它叙述了一部凯旋式的神圣发展史，从1861年解放农奴到1936年斯大林宪法以宪法形式确认社会主义；它还列举了人民事业的一切敌人，从民粹派、孟什维克直到托洛茨基分子。而在第四章第二节“论辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义”中，它给出了斯大林本人对马克思列宁主义基本原理的阐述。这里终于汇集了三十年代所有重大“思想”发展，并对生活与思想的一切重要问题给出了答案。这是成熟时期苏维埃主义的权威正典，也是直到斯大林去世很久以后始终套在一切文化生活上的思想紧身衣。尽管后来做过若干修订，《简明教程》的基本教义只要苏维埃政权存在就不会被否定。
en: This document pulled the whole new Soviet culture together. It set forth a triumphal and sacred history of developments, from the Emancipation of the serfs in 1861 to the codification of socialism in the Stalin Constitution of 1936; and it catalogued all the enemies of the people’s cause, from the Populists and the Mensheviks to the Trotskyites. And in chapter 4, section 2, “On Dialectical and Historical Materialism,” it gave Stalin’s own exposition of the fundamentals of Marxism-Leninism. Here at last was a compendium of the major “intellectual” developments of the thirties, and the answer to all significant questions of life and thought. This was the authoritative canon of high Sovietism, and the intellectual straitjacket around all cultural life until well after Stalin’s death. Despite a number of later emendations, the basic tenets of the
would not be repudiated as long as the Soviet regime lasted.

zh: 文学战线上也发生了类似的巩固和国有化过程。随着计划全速推进，阐释其意义已不能留给拉普那些自行其是的意识形态分子。1932年，该组织被解散，取而代之的是国家资助的新的作家协会，以无产阶级现实主义作家马克西姆·高尔基为名誉教父，政治局委员安德烈·日丹诺夫为主要意识形态家。

1934年，作协召开第一次代表大会；许多同路人宣布放弃自己的错误，日丹诺夫则宣布了社会主义现实主义学说。此后，用斯大林的话说，作家应当成为“人类灵魂的工程师”。具体而言，这意味着他们应当以十九世纪现实主义那种平易近人的方式写作，而不同于二十年代晦涩的“形式主义者”和现代主义者。然而，与此同时，他们不应机械地反映现实，而应提供社会主义奉献与成就的英雄化、理想化典范。此外，题材应当取自党路线所规定的当下实际任务，以及努力完成这些任务的工人和积极分子的生活。因此，社会主义现实主义事实上意味着服从党性的理想主义，而最初左翼的无产阶级艺术观念，变成了党国的直接“社会命令”。左翼冲动又一次在其表面失败后存活了下来，因为把美学视为政治的另一种表达的基本观念仍然存在，只是形式更加粗糙，存在于已告完成的斯大林主义文化之中。
en: An analogous process of consolidation and nationalization occurred on the literary front. As the Plan went into high gear, expounding its meaning could, not be left to the freelance ideologues of RAPP. In 1932 that organization was dissolved and a new, state-sponsored Union of Writers was created in its stead, with the proletarian realist Maxim Gorky as honorary godfather and the Politburo member Andrei Zhdanov as principal ideologue.

In 1934 the Union held its first congress; various fellow travellers recanted their errors and Zhdanov proclaimed the doctrine of socialist realism. Henceforth, writers were to be, in Stalin’s words, “engineers of human souls.” Specifically, this meant that they should write in the accessible manner of nineteenth-century realism, unlike the abstruse “formalists” and modernists of the twenties. At the same time, however, they should not mirror reality mechanically, but instead should offer heroic, idealized models of socialist devotion and achievement. Subjects, moreover, should be taken from the immediate, practical tasks set by the Party line, and from the lives of workers and activists attempting to carry it out. Thus socialist realism in fact meant Party-minded idealism, and the initial leftist idea of proletarian art became the direct “social command” of the Party-state. Yet again the leftist impetus survived its apparent defeat, for the basic notion of aesthetics as transposed politics was still present, though in cruder form, in the completed Stalinist culture.

zh: 一旦为文学制定出这一公式，把它应用于一切艺术就很容易了。到1936年，有了电影工作者协会，随后又有作曲家协会和美术家协会；社会主义现实主义学说也被调整以适应每个协会的活动。每个协会在其领域都拥有垄断权；它们全都受干部职务名称表制度的支配，实际上由党的干部治理。与此同时，这个“创造性知识分子”群体同其他类型的干部一样，获得丰厚报酬并被纳入精英。当然，那些无法按社会命令行事的创作者，有时会面临与古拉格同样严厉的惩罚，奥西普·曼德尔施塔姆和伊萨克·巴别尔的遭遇即是例证。
en: Once this formula had been worked out for literature, it was easy to apply it in all the arts. By 1936 there was a Union of Cinematographers, and then a Composers’ Union and a Union of Artists; and the doctrine of socialist realism was adapted to the activity of each of these Unions. Each had a monopoly in its field; all were under the dispensatipn of the

and in fact governed by Party men. At the same time, this “creative intelligentsia,” like other types of cadres, was richly rewarded and integrated into the elite. And, of course, creative figures who could not live by the social command risked penalties at times as severe as the Gulag, as in the cases of Osip Mandelshtam and Isaak Babel.

zh: 以这种方式，一切“软”形式的文化都被同化进党路线。但就连“硬”形式的文化——自然科学，其研究对象和方法论历来被视为不受任何社会影响的客观性的典范——此时也开始被意识形态化。
en: In this manner all the “soft” forms of culture were assimilated into the Party line. But even the “hard” forms of culture—the natural sciences, whose subject matter and methodology traditionally epitomized an objectivity immune to any social influence—now began to be ideologized.

zh: 首要的案例是遗传学，这场运动的领袖是特罗菲姆·李森科。

他是一位自学成才的生物学家，反对孟德尔关于生物特征遗传的理论，主张一种以更早的一位俄国科学家命名的新拉马克主义立场，他称之为米丘林主义。这种新遗传学认为，生物特征可以后天获得，因此可以通过操纵环境来改变。李森科据此谴责孟德尔主义是反动的，并颂扬米丘林主义补充了马克思主义关于人性可通过社会环境变化而塑造的论点。这一切都与通过五年计划改造社会相关联，尤其与培育作物新品种、以补救集体农业一再灾难性表现这一希望相关联。李森科做了没有定论的实验来证明自己的理论，但尽管相对失败，他还是引起了斯大林的注意；后者也是自学出身的人民之子，容易相信集体农庄产量会奇迹般提高的许诺。到那个十年结束时，孟德尔主义者已基本被逐出苏联生物学，李森科主义则确立了将持续到赫鲁晓夫时代的霸权。
en: The principal case was genetics, and the leader of the campaign was Trofim Lysenko.

A self-taught biologist, he argued against the Mendelian theory of inherited biological characteristics in favor of a neo-Lamarckian position that he called Michurinism, after an earlier Russian scientist. This new genetics held that biological characteristics were acquired and therefore could be changed by manipulating the environment. Lysenko accordingly denounced Mendelianism as reactionary and extolled Michurinism as complementary to the Marxist thesis of the malleability of human nature through change in the social environment. All of this was linked to the transformation of society through the Five-Year Plans, and in particular to the hope of breeding new varieties of crops to remedy the ever-disastrous performance of collective agriculture. Lysenko performed inconclusive experiments to prove his theories, but despite this relative failure he caught the attention of Stalin, another self-educated man of the people who was vulnerable to the promise of a miraculous improvement in kolkhoz production. By the end of the decade the Mendelians had been largely purged from Soviet biology, and Lysenkoism had established an hegemony that would last into the Khrushchev era.

zh: 然而，最硬的硬学科——物理学和化学——大体上大体没有直接从属于党的路线。

理论物理学的某些方面——最著名的是爱因斯坦的相对论，以及后来的控制论——被谴责为唯心主义的形式。辩证唯物主义也被宣布为一切自然现象在原则上的理论基础。但就实际而言，物理学和化学大体上未受干扰，至少部分原因是苏联物理学家了解原子的军事潜力。第二次世界大战期间，物理学家坦率地告诉斯大林，意识形态必须被排除在他们的学科之外，而斯大林在这个关乎实力的实际问题上同意了。结果，战后苏联将以令西方震惊的速度造出核武器。
en: The hardest of the hard disciplines, physics and chemistry, however, by and large escaped direct subordination to the Party line.

Certain aspects of theoretical physics—most notably Einstein’s theories of relativity and, later, cybernetics—were condemned as forms of idealism. And dialectical materialism was declared to be in principle the theoretical basis of all natural phenomena. But as a practical matter physics and chemistry were largely left alone, at least in part because Soviet physicists were aware of the military potential of the atom. During the Second World War the physicists told Stalin frankly that ideology must be kept out of their discipline, and Stalin, in this practical matter of power, agreed. As a result, after the war the Soviet Union would produce nuclear weapons with a rapidity that astounded the West.

zh: 因此，到1938年《简明教程》出版时，几乎整个俄国文化都已被国有化，并同时以两种方式被纳入意识形态统治。第一，一切创造性活动部门都被赋予了马克思列宁主义的方法论和哲学基础；第二，每个部门的活动都服从于党的直接行政命令。
en: Thus, by 1938 and the publication of the

, virtually the whole of Russian culture had been nationalized as well as ideologized in two senses. First, all branches of creative activity had been given a Marxist-Leninist methodological and philosophical underpinning; second, activity in each branch had been made subject to the direct administrative commands of the Party.

zh: 苏维埃极权制度由此终于完备：从经济到文化，生活的每一个方面都被政治化；而在所有地方，政治都表达着党国的意识形态目的。整个苏联生活此时都指向一个目标：社会主义的建设与保卫。一切都根据其与这一最高目标的关系来评价，而一切无助于实现这一目标的东西，本身即是应从制度中清除的敌对因素。意识形态统治的党治公式此时已被推至其逻辑结论。
en: The Soviet totalitarian system thereby at last became complete: Every aspect of life, from economics to culture, had been made political; and everywhere the politics expressed the ideological purposes of the Party-state. The whole of Soviet life was now directed towards one end: the building and defense of socialism. Everything was evaluated in terms of its relation to this supreme goal, and everything that did not contribute to achieving this goal was ipso facto a hostile element to be purged from the system. The formula of ideocratic partocracy had now been carried to its logical conclusion.

zh: 至少，制度的正式结构如此。但问题仍然是：政权在实践中能在多大程度上按自己的目的塑造民众。显然，党的控制并非彻底到克里姆林宫的一纸命令就能随意号令全国。尽管俄国已不再存在具有组织结构的市民社会，但人口中仍存在群体凝聚的要素，它们在政权的正式结构之下构成一种影子社会。
en: Such, at least, was the formal structure of the system. But the question remains as to how far in practice the regime was able to mold the population to its purposes. Obviously, the Party’s control was not so total that an order from the Kremlin could command the entire country at will. Even though a structured civil society no longer existed in Russia, there nonetheless existed elements of group cohesion in the population that constituted a kind of shadow society beneath the formal structures of the regime.

zh: 而这个影子社会总能找到隐蔽的方式来抵抗或规避国家的僭越，从而限制国家的行动自由，迫使它部分地重塑政策。一个首要的例子是农民抵抗，它迫使斯大林作出让步，给予家庭自留地和集体农庄市场。一个更重要的例子是由非法却不可或缺的私人经营活动构成的“影子经济”，它从斯大林时代一直与计划并行，直到制度崩溃。其他例子还可以在斯达汉诺夫运动的初期阶段、对俄国民族传统的让步，以及干部日益增多的特权中找到。的确，斯大林治下的政权不得不一路临时应变，最终形成与其原初目标相去甚远的混合产物，这整个过程本身就说明了影子社会持久的顽抗。而社会史修正主义的功绩之一，正是把国家与“社会”的这种互动揭示为苏联发展的主要线索之一。
en: And this shadow society always found covert ways to resist or evade the pretensions of the state, thereby restricting the state’s freedom of maneuver and forcing it to partially reshape its policies. A prime example is the peasant resistance that extracted from Stalin the concession of the family plot and the kolkhoz market. A still more important example is the “shadow economy” of illegal yet indispensable private entrepreneurship that paralled the Plan from Stalin to the collapse of the system. Other examples may be found in the initial phase of the Stakhanovite movement, in concessions to the Russian national tradition, and in the increasing privileges of cadres. Indeed, the whole process by which the regime under Stalin was obliged to improvise its way to a bastard version of its original goals is an illustration of the enduring recalcitrance of the shadow society. And it is one of the merits of social history revisionism to have brought out this interaction of state and “society” as a major thread of Soviet development.

zh: 然而，这种互动很难说成某些人所主张的“谈判”，也很难说社会具有同等的行动能力，因为整个人口都在政治、经济和文化全部被压缩进一个“单组织”党国的环境中活动。正是这一结构性因素使制度成为极权的；政权在实践中未能实现对社会的完全控制，这几乎不改变这一基本现实。对任何社会的完全国家控制都是不可能的；但一个把社会组织全面纳入国家的框架，
在一套总体化意识形态和恐怖的支持下实现。
en: Nonetheless, such interaction hardly amounted to “negotiations,” as some would have it, or to an equal ability for society to act, for the entire population operated in a context where politics, the economy, and culture had all been collapsed into a “mono-organizational” Party-state. It is this structural factor that made the system totalitarian; that in practice the regime fell short of total control of society hardly alters this basic reality. Total state control of any society is impossible; but a total state framework of social organization
be achieved with a totalizing ideology buttressed by terror.

zh: 此外，即便在实践中，党国的影响也是压倒性的。因为给农民家庭自留地这一让步，与政权对整座村庄的攫取相比微不足道；正如工人节制劳动强度的能力无力改变计划的霸权。而如果我们超越这些表面的社会事实向上看，就会看到，农民、工人和干部同样承受着一种令人心智麻木的义务：必须认同、或至少口头上承认社会主义是生命的最高意义。因此，把苏联社会的拔河称为“多元主义”，或在任何适用于没有意识形态国家机器的社会的意义上称为初生的“民主”，都是相当滥用的说法。因为正是苏维埃制度的意识形态僭越界定了它的社会学独特性。其结果是国家目的无处不在、渗透全部生活，这在历史上没有先例。
en: Moreover, even in practice the presence of the Party-state was overwhelming. For the concession of the family plot to the peasants was derisory in comparison to the regime’s appropriation of the whole village, just as the workers’ ability to ration their efforts was powerless to alter the hegemony of the Plan. And if we trouble to look upward from the bare social facts, we see that there weighed upon peasants, workers, and cadres alike the mind-numbing obligation to subscribe, or at least to render lip-service, to socialism as the supreme meaning of life. It is thus quite abusive to call the Soviet social tug-of-war “pluralism” or incipient “democracy” in any sense that is applicable to societies without an ideological state apparatus. For it is the ideological pretension of the Soviet system that defined its sociological uniqueness. The result was a pervasiveness of state purposes in all of life that was without historical precedent.

zh: 这种意识形态统治的党治的胜利，伴随着斯大林个人崇拜的成熟。从1934年的胜利者代表大会开始，人们习惯上只用最夸张的称号来称呼他，从天才到艺术与科学的泰斗，从儿童最伟大的朋友到各民族之父和世界无产阶级领袖，等等。1939年他六十岁生日的庆典是一场名副其实的神化。而且，如我们所见，他
亲自做出了关键决定，无论是在这十年的经济革命中，还是在文化的国有化中。因此，人们很容易得出结论说，所有这些事业都是为了增强他的个人权力，而一个最终以对他个人的崇拜为顶点的政权，基本上是他个人的创造。
en: This triumph of ideocratic partocracy was accompanied by the maturation of the personal cult of Stalin. Beginning with the Congress of the Victors in 1934, he was habitually referred to only with the most extravagant epithets, from genius to coryphaeus of the arts and sciences, from the greatest friend of children to the father of the peoples and the leader of the world proletariat, and so forth. The celebration of his sixtieth birthday in 1939 was a veritable apotheosis. And, as we have seen, he

personally make the crucial decisions, both in the economic revolution of the decade and in the nationalization of culture. Therefore, the temptation is great to conclude that all of these enterprises were conducted to enhance his personal power, and that a regime that culminated in the cult of his person was basically his personal creation.

zh: 然而，一个更可信的观点是：在崇拜时代，斯大林是制度的表达，而不是它的创造者。因为他在文化战线上的一切干预，都以一个现存的制度和一套现成的意识形态为前提。在每个部门，新经济政策都已经创造出一个专家“协会”或“团体”——无论是无产阶级作家还是马克思主义历史学家——而每个这样的群体都已发展出一套马克思主义的论证，主张把自己的学科服从于党的当下任务，并清除不循规蹈矩者。因此，斯大林对这些事业的收编，很难说是一次根本性飞跃：他不过是把这些组织统统置于中央委员会意识形态部和他个人意志的管辖之下。于是整个文化被集中到单一的国家机构之下；这一情况使一切比以前更粗糙，对不正统者更危险，但它也代表着一种合乎逻辑的生长，而不是某种想象出来的背叛。
en: A more plausible view, however, is that Stalin in the era of the cult was an expression of the system rather than its creator. For all of his interventions on the cultural front presupposed an existing system and a ready-made ideology. In each sector the NEP had already created a “union” or “society” of specialists—whether proletarian writers or Marxist historians—and each such group had developed a Marxist justification for subordinating its discipline to the immediate tasks of the Party and for eliminating nonconformists. Stalin’s appropriation of these enterprises, therefore, was hardly a quantum leap: He simply subordinated the lot of them to the ideological department of the Central Committee and to his personal will. Hence all culture was centralized under a single state agency, a circumstance that made everything cruder than before and more dangerous for the unorthodox, but one that also represented a logical growth rather than some imaginary betrayal.

zh: 因此，斯大林对新经济政策文化的所作所为，与他对待托洛茨基—孟什维克的新经济政策计划一样：他把它吞并，并通过把建设完整社会主义从未来目标变为实际任务来改造它。二十年代一切其他形式的战斗左翼主义和“革命之梦”也都如此。但由于在实践中建设社会主义，结果远比阶级斗争最残酷的理论预期所想象的还要残酷，由此产生的斯大林主义文化也就相应地残酷。
en: Thus Stalin did with the NEP culture what he had done with the Trotskyite-Menshevik NEP Plan: He annexed it and transformed it by subordinating it to the actual rather than the prospective task of building integral socialism. The same occurred with all the other forms of militant leftism and the “revolutionary dreams” of the twenties. But since building socialism in practice turned out to be far more brutal than even the most brutal theoretical anticipations of class warfare had imagined, the resulting Stalinist culture was a comparably brutal affair.

zh: 对斯大林崇拜本身也可以说类似的话。斯大林无疑享受这种阿谀，但并未完全被其蒙蔽，因此这一崇拜的形成不能完全不考虑他的个性。但这一崇拜在制度中也承担着重要功能。人们常常提出一个假设：落后的俄国农民历来在沙皇身上拥有一个神圣的父亲形象，因此斯大林崇拜为人民提供了一种供其原始情感寄托的“圣像”。
按照这种观点，这一崇拜没有什么特别社会主义或党性的东西；它毋宁是俄国落后性所承载的专制与东正教重负的延续。然而，鉴于斯大林对农民所做的一切，还要坚持他们需要把他神化，至少可以说是怪诞的。此外，非常清楚的是，这一崇拜出自党，而不是出自人民。
en: Something analogous may be said of the cult of Stalin itself. Stalin no doubt enjoyed the adulation without being entirely taken in by it, so some role must be accorded to his personality in the creation of the cult. But the cult also served a major function within the system. The hypothesis has often been advanced that the backward Russian peasant had always had a sacred father-figure in the tsar, and that the Stalin cult therefore offered the people a kind of “icon” for their primitive emotions.”
In this view, the cult has nothing especially socialist or

about it; it is rather a prolongation of the autocratic and Orthodox burden of Russian backwardness. Given what Stalin had done to the peasants, however, to insist on their need to deify him is, to say the least, bizarre. It is very clear, moreover, that the cult emerged from the Party, not from the people.

zh: 如前所述，斯大林崇拜源于新经济政策时期的列宁崇拜，而那个崇拜同样源于党，而不是人民。

诚然，如列宁遗孀所断言，列宁本人不会想要任何这样的尊崇，因为他在生前一直避之不及。但这无关紧要：他无法控制人们对他个人的利用，正如他无法控制人们对他政治遗产的利用。然而这并不意味着列宁崇拜不是从那份遗产中逻辑地产生出来的——那份遗产使“党［用托洛茨基的话说］成为赐予无产阶级的唯一的历史工具”。因此，列宁崇拜连同它的遗体、陵墓和马克思列宁主义正统，是党对自己的崇拜：那个永远正确的领袖，是那个将永远正确的党所必需的护身符。正如马雅可夫斯基所写：“列宁曾经活过，列宁活着，列宁将永远活下去！”
en: The Stalin cult, as already noted, had its origin in the Lenin cult of the NEP, and that cult, too, originated in the Party, not in the people.

To be sure, Lenin himself, as his widow averred, would not have wanted any such veneration, since he had always shunned it in his lifetime. But this is beside the point: He could no more control the uses made of his person than he could those made of his political legacy. Yet this does not mean that the Lenin cult does not follow logically from that legacy, which made “the Party [in Trotsky’s words] the single historical instrument given to the proletariat.” Thus, the Lenin cult, with its mummy, its mausoleum, and its Marxist-Leninist orthodoxy, was the Party’s cult of itself: The Leader who had always been right was the necessary talisman for the Party that would always be right. As Maiakovskii put it, “Lenin lived, Lenin lives, Lenin will live!”

zh: 斯大林——他那个时代的列宁、党之无谬与不朽的新化身——不可避免地使这一崇拜适应自己的领导。的确，鉴于他实际上的枢纽地位，不这样做反倒不明智。但当“领袖崇拜”被施加于一个活人时，它恰恰因这一事实而被放大。而当领袖带领人民经历一次又一次剧烈的革命性断裂时，对他个人准魔力式能力的聚焦就进一步强化。在持续危机的形势下，即便对一个非极权社会来说，政治的英雄理论也是自然的求助对象——美国历任行政首脑、丘吉尔和戴高乐的经历都可为证。但当社会是极权的时候，所谓的英雄就被拔高为超人、近乎神明。于是斯大林，一个几乎从不与自己国家的民众直接接触的人，被他在石膏、绘画和胶片中无所不在的形象，变成了大众的具有超凡魅力的圣像。
en: Stalin, the Lenin of his day and the new incarnation of the Party’s infallibility and immortality, inevitably adapted this cult to his own leadership. Indeed, given his real pivotal position, it would have been impolitic for him not to have done so. But when a “leader cult” is applied to a living person, it is magnified by that very fact. And when the Leader leads the population from one wrenching revolutionary break to another, the focus on the quasi-magical powers of his person is further enhanced. In a situation of constant crisis, the hero theory of politics is a natural recourse even for a nontotalitarian society—as the careers of any number of American chief executives, or of Churchill and de Gaulle, attest. But when the society is totalitarian, the alleged hero is inflated to superhuman, quasi-divine proportions. So Stalin, who had almost no direct contact with the people of his country, was transformed by the omnipresence of his image in plaster, paint, or celluloid into a charismatic icon for the masses.

zh: 然而在这样的制度中，这种显然的荒谬实际上是有功能的：领袖成为意识形态的化身和核心支柱，把整个意识形态统治的幻景维系在一起。因此到1939年、他的国内工作主要部分完成时，斯大林已成为他自己机器上的最高齿轮。因为这样的总体领袖正是这种总体制度逻辑的产物，而可怜的俄国庄稼汉与此关系甚微。而如果没有这样的制度，仅凭斯大林这个人，绝不可能搞成斯大林主义这样荒谬的东西。
en: Yet in such a system this patent absurdity is in fact functional: The Leader becomes the incarnate ideological linchpin holding the whole ideocratic phantasmagoria together. Thus by 1939, when the main part of his domestic work was done, Stalin had become the supreme cog in his own machine. For such a total leader was the product of the logic of such a total system, and the poor Russian muzhik had precious little to do with it. And without such a system, the mere man Stalin could never have gotten away with anything so absurd as Stalinism.

zh: 大恐怖
en: THE GREAT TERROR

zh: 没有总体制度的支持，斯大林也不可能搞成大恐怖。当然，他再一次是主要推动者，因此人们很容易把他当作全部故事。然而这又一次是一个更广泛的过程在起作用，其源泉在制度本身。但在本案中，要发现这一过程的各个环节要困难得多，因为苏联领导层把痕迹掩盖得太好，以至于连基本叙事都无法重建。集体化的基本轮廓最终为世人所知；清洗无疑将永远保留某种神秘。因此，任何研究这一问题的人，都必须进行非同寻常程度的猜测；在无法证明的地方，只能以推测是否合乎情理作为判断依据。这就是此处采用的方法。
en: Nor could Stalin have gotten away with the Great Terror without the support of a total system. Once again, of course, he was the prime mover, and so the temptation is great to make him the whole story. Yet once again a broader process was at work, and its wellspring was in the system itself. But in this case it is much more difficult to discover the steps in that process, for the Soviet leadership covered its tracks too well to make it possible to reconstruct even the basic narrative. The essential outlines of the collectivization eventually came to be known; the purges will no doubt always remain something of a mystery. Anyone who approaches them, therefore, must engage in an unusual degree of conjecture; and where proof is impossible, plausibility will have to suffice. This is the method employed here.

zh: 说清洗是通常意义上的“理性”政治行动，那太过分了。但它们确实具有一种基于成熟苏维埃制度本性和当时形势的内在理据。从广义上说，这一理据在于一个已经提及的事实：三十年代中期是社会主义乌托邦作为
与其
的分水岭：完整社会主义的工具性纲领确实被执行了，但其后果却是对预期道德结果的滑稽歪曲。这一不可接受的事实，必须以某种方式被否定或否认。
en: It would be too much to say that the purges were a “rational” political undertaking in the usual sense of that term. They did nonetheless have a rationale in the nature of the mature Soviet system and in the circumstances of the day. In a broad sense this rationale lay in the fact, already alluded to, that the mid-thirties marked the watershed between the socialist Utopia
and its realization

: The instrumental program of integral socialism had indeed been carried out, but its consequences were a travesty of the expected moral results. This unacceptable fact somehow had to be negated or denied.

zh: 因此，清洗的起源在于第一个五年计划的创伤，尤其是集体化的灾难。正如帕斯捷尔纳克在《日瓦戈医生》中所说：
en: The origin of the purges thus lies in the trauma of the First Five-Year Plan, and in particular in the disaster of collectivization. As Pasternak put the matter in

children: 集体化是一项错误而失败的措施，而承认错误是不可能的。为了掩盖失败，必须用一切恐怖手段治好人们独立思考和判断的习惯，迫使他们看见并不存在的东西，断言与他们亲眼所见完全相反的东西。由此产生了叶若夫时期前所未有的残酷，产生了一部并不打算实施的宪法，以及一种并非建立在选举原则之上的选举。

Collectivization was an erroneous and unsuccessful measure and it was impossible to admit the error. To conceal the failure people had to be cured, by every means of terrorism, of the habit of thinking and judging for themselves, and forced to see what didn’t exist, to assert the very opposite of what their eyes told them. From this came the unprecedented cruelty of the
, the proclamation of a constitution that was not meant to be applied, and the introduction of elections not founded on the elective principle.

zh: 因此，现存现实必须通过创造一种新文化、或一种超现实来加以否定，而民众必须在恐怖威胁下接受这种文化为关于新社会主义的真理。这就是把计划与清洗联系起来的基本逻辑。
en: Existing reality therefore had to be denied through the creation of a new culture, or a surreality, and the population had to be terrorized into accepting this culture as the truth about the new socialism. This is the basic logic that connects the Plan to the Purge.

zh: 但这一过程是通过三个更具体的问题展开的，每个问题都有自己的逻辑，它们在1932年第一个计划结束到1936年第一次公审开始之间的岁月里摆在制度面前。第一个问题是斯大林仍然不稳固的地位，他当时还不是绝对的独裁者。第二个是党在一个刚刚被第二次革命翻了个底朝天的社会中的不稳定状态。第三个是国际形势——它恰在第二次革命完成之际突然变得危险。
en: But this process worked itself out through three more specific problems, each with its own logic, that confronted the system in the years between the end of the first Plan in 1932 and the start of the first purge trial in 1936. The first of these problems was the still insecure position of Stalin, who was not yet absolute dictator. The second was the unstable state of the Party in a society that had just been turned upside down by the Second Revolution. And the third was an international situation that suddenly became dangerous just when the Second Revolution was completed.

zh: 这三个问题在1936年汇合，产生了三场引人注目的公审中的第一场；这些审判吸引了全世界的注意，此后一直是关于清洗现象的猜测中心。但这些审判针对的是旧反对派的过气人物，是那些已不再有足够可信度去图谋取代斯大林的人。远比这出公开情节剧重要的，是1937年和1938年席卷党、管理干部、军官团、文化精英和安全警察自身的规模巨大、不为外界所见的深层清洗。这场深度清洗不是针对旧反对派，而是针对忠实的斯大林派，是针对领袖在建设社会主义中的忠实同志。因此，大恐怖实际上相当于斯大林和最高领导层对他们所领导的制度中大部分关键人员发动的一场巨大政变。它确实是斯大林自上而下的第二次革命。
en: These three problems converged in 1936 to produce the first of the three spectacular show trials that riveted the world’s attention and that have ever since been at the center of speculation about the purge phenomenon. But these trials were directed at the has-beens of the old oppositions, at individuals who were no longer credible enough to aspire to displace Stalin. Far more important than this public melodrama was the enormous and invisible purge-in-depth that swept through the Party, the managerial cadres, the officer corps, the cultural elite, and the security police itself in 1937 and 1938. This purge-in-depth was carried out not against the old oppositionists but against good Stalin men, the Leader’s faithful comrades in the building of socialism. Thus the Great Terror in fact amounted to a gigantic coup d’état carried out by Stalin and the top leadership against most of the key personnel of the system they were leading. It was indeed Stalin’s Second Revolution from above.

zh: 导致这场政变的第一个因素，源于斯大林的总路线在1932—1933年几近灾难。尽管党在紧急状态下团结一致，斯大林的错误仍在私下受到广泛批评，尤其是旧反对派成员。仍留在党内的托洛茨基同情者经常把材料寄给他，供其在巴黎的《反对派公报》上发表；看来1932年莫斯科甚至存在一个小型的有组织团体——远称不上恐怖组织——与托洛茨基的儿子保持联系。
更具威胁的是，同年一批与米哈伊尔·留京有关的“右派”提出了一份纲领，要求停止强行工业化和集体化，并撤换斯大林。看来这种情绪在左派中也有共鸣，甚至在一些此前一直是斯大林追随者的人中间也有共鸣。
en: The first factor leading to this coup d’état grew out of the circumstance that Stalin’s General Line had come near to disaster in 1932-1933. Although the Party closed ranks during the emergency, Stalin’s errors were widely criticized in private, especially by members of the old oppositions. Sympathizers of Trotsky who were still in the Party regularly sent him damning material for publication in his
in Paris; it seems that in 1932 there even existed a small, organized, though hardly terrorist, group in Moscow that maintained contact with Trotsky’s son.

More threatening still, in the same year a group of “Rightists” associated with Mikhail Riutin produced a platform calling for a halt to crash industrialization and collectivization and for the removal of Stalin. It also seems that such sentiments were shared on the Left and indeed among some who had hitherto been Stalin’s adherents.

zh: 这是对事业和对领袖的背叛，而且发生在战斗最危险的时刻。斯大林的反应是把留京纲领的十八名签署者开除出党；但看来他还想更进一步，处死留京。然而，这一要求撞上了党的一大禁忌：布尔什维克始终铭记法国革命的先例，决心不让自己的革命吞噬自己的孩子，因为领袖之间的致命争斗可能最终毁掉整个运动。因此政治局拒绝批准死刑，而看来基洛夫是这一惩罚的主要反对者。但这一失败让斯大林耿耿于怀，于是他认定，若要治理党，就必须打破这一禁忌。然而，由于当时无法强加自己的意志，他退却了，等待时机，如同他在与先前各反对派的冲突中多次所做的那样。
en: This was treason to the cause and to the Leader just at the most dangerous moment in the battle. Stalin reacted by having the eighteen signers of the Riutin platform expelled from the Party; but it seems he wished to go further and have Riutin executed. With this demand, however, he came up against a major Party taboo: The Bolsheviks, ever mindful of the French revolutionary precedent, were determined that their Revolution would not devour its children, for lethal strife among the leaders could end by destroying the whole movement. The Politburo therefore refused to permit the death penalty, and it seems that Kirov was the sanction’s chief opponent. But this defeat rankled Stalin, so he determined that he must break that taboo if ever he were to govern the Party. However, since he could not impose his will at that moment, he retreated and bided his time, as he had done on a number of occasions in conflicts with earlier oppositions.

zh: 看来斯大林权威在1934年第十七次党代表大会上还受到了进一步挑战。

尽管代表大会公开对总书记大加赞颂，但在最近的攻势期间，对他的领导仍有一股批评的暗流。看来一些批评者还希望基洛夫成为合适而更温和的接班人：他是全国第二重要的党组织即列宁格勒组织的领袖；他没有因在集体化中扮演核心角色而受牵连；他与其说是斯大林的一个谄媚者（如莫洛托夫），不如说是他的盟友；而且他不是狡猾的高加索人，而是健壮、脚踏实地的俄罗斯人。看来在选入新中央委员会的选举中，基洛夫获得的票数还多于斯大林。
en: It seems that there was further challenge to Stalin’s authority—at the Seventeenth Party Congress in 1934.

Although the Congress heaped the most lavish public praise on its General Secretary, there was an undercurrent of criticism of his leadership during the recent Offensive. It seems also that some of the critics hoped that Kirov might be a suitable and more moderate successor: He was the leader of the second most important Party organization in the country, that of Leningrad; he had not been compromised by a central role in carrying out collectivization; he was more an ally of Stalin than a toady such as Molotov; and he was no sly Caucasian, but a hearty down-to-earth Russian. It also appears that Kirov received more votes than Stalin for election to the new Central Committee.

zh: 但绝对没有证据表明存在一个基洛夫纲领，也没有证据表明他把自己视为反对派领袖或斯大林的可能的接班人。相反，自1926年他从季诺维也夫手中接管列宁格勒领导权以来，他一直是斯大林的人，而他在此期间的所有讲话都完全是强硬路线。然而，斯大林对基洛夫的人气、以及很可能围绕这位较年轻者的一厢情愿的期待感到不快，这是可以理解的。这更有可能，因为斯大林不可能不知道，他在大攻势期间的失误如此之大，以至于在任何正常的政治制度中，这些都足以成为解除其权力的理由。而共产主义制度仍然保留了足够的社会民主主义宪政遗迹，使这样的行动在制度形式上成为可能。
en: But there is absolutely no evidence that there was a Kirov program, or that he saw himself as an opposition leader or possible successor to Stalin. On the contrary, he had been a Stalin man since he took over the Leningrad leadership from Zinoviev in 1926, and all of his speeches of the period were thoroughly hardline. It is understandable nonetheless that Stalin should take umbrage at Kirov’s popularity and at the wishful thinking that probably surrounded this younger man. This is all the more likely since Stalin could not help but know that his blunders during the Great Offensive were so great that in any normal political system they would have been cause for removing him from power. And the Communist system still retained enough vestiges of Social Democratic constitutionalism to make such action technically possible.

zh: 但这一切是否意味着斯大林是1934年12月1日基洛夫遇刺的幕后主使？如果斯大林想要一场清洗，他首先需要一场紧急状态来为行使特别权力提供理由；而为了一场紧急状态，他需要一桩暴行来证明国家处于危险之中。前一年，国会纵火案（当时人人都错误地认为它是纳粹放的）恰好为希特勒提供了这样一个机会，这一事实很难不引起斯大林的注意。基洛夫之死是斯大林的国会纵火案吗？
en: But does all of this mean that Stalin was the author of Kirov’s assassination on December 1, 1934? If Stalin wanted a purge, he first needed an emergency to justify the exercise of special powers; and for an emergency he needed an atrocity to demonstrate that the country was in danger. The previous year the Reichstag fire (which at the time everyone erroneously believed had been set by the Nazis) had furnished Hitler just such an occasion, and this fact could hardly have escaped Stalin’s attention. Was Kirov’s murder Stalin’s Reichstag fire?

zh: 这桩被称为“世纪谋杀”的疑案，也许永远无法解开。赫鲁晓夫1956年在第二十次党代表大会上的秘密报告中强烈暗示斯大林有罪，而且有大量间接证据支持这一假设。刺客列昂尼德·尼古拉耶夫轻易进入基洛夫办公室，以及刺杀后剧中关键人物立即遭遇的神秘事故，都表明这桩罪行是内务人民委员部（NKVD，政治警察自1934年以来的名称）所为。同样可疑的是斯大林反应的迅速。十二小时之内，他就发布了一项特别法令，规定惩处恐怖行为的快速程序，并乘专列抵达列宁格勒，亲自审讯尼古拉耶夫。尽管如此，没有斯大林参与的直接证据，而且也有有说服力的反对论据。他几乎不会希望为刺杀共产党领袖开创先例，也不会愿意冒一次对基洛夫行刺失败的风险。
en: The mystery of this “murder of the century,” as it has been called, will probably never be solved. Khrushchev strongly hinted at Stalin’s guilt in his secret speech to the Twentieth Party Congress in 1956, and there is much circumstantial evidence in favor of this hypothesis. The ease with which the assassin, Leonid Nikolaev, gained access to Kirov’s office, and the mysterious accidents that befell key players in the drama immediately after the assassination, indicate that the crime was the work of the NKVD (as the political police had been called since 1934). Just as suspicious is the rapidity of Stalin’s reaction. Within twelve hours he had issued a special decree establishing expeditious procedures for punishing terrorist acts and reached Leningrad by special train to interrogate Nikolaev personally. Still, there is no direct evidence of Stalin’s involvement, and there are persuasive arguments against, it, He would hardly wish to set a precedent for the assassination of Communist leaders, or to have risked a botched attempt on Kirov’s life.

zh: 无论如何，基洛夫之死让斯大林有了“反对党在逻辑上导致犯罪”的“证据”。于是，基洛夫之死的道德责任在1935年很快被归到季诺维也夫和加米涅夫头上，并从他们出发，“阴谋”以同心圆的方式不断扩大。这两位领袖于1936年因直接责任受审；皮亚塔科夫和拉狄克在1937年的第二次审判中被牵连定罪；最后，布哈林、李可夫和内务人民委员部首脑亨里希·亚戈达成为1938年最后一次审判的被告。这些党的领袖此时被定性为“人民公敌”，这一标签也用于深度清洗中所有较不知名的受害者。此外，消灭他们的理论依据，正是斯大林在发动第一个五年计划革命时所使用的那一套。人们再次宣称，国家越接近社会主义，敌人的抵抗就越激烈，因此对他们的阶级斗争也必须越激烈。这是对马克思主义首要原则的终极贬损，因为清洗中根本不涉及任何社会阶级的迹象；有的只是领导层对党的大多数的斗争。
en: In any event, with Kirov’s death Stalin had “proof that opposition to the Party logically led to crime. Thus moral responsibility for Kirov’s death was soon attributed in 1935 to Zinoviev and Kamenev, and from them the “plot” expanded in concentric circles. These two leaders were tried for direct responsibility in 1936; Piatakov and Radek were incriminated in a second trial in 1937; and finally Bukharin, Rykov, and the NKVD chief Genrikh Yagoda became the villains of a final trial in 1938. These Party leaders were now branded “enemies of the people,” a label used also for all the lesser victims of the purge-in-depth. Moreover, the theoretical justification for their elimination was the same that Stalin had employed in launching the revolution of the First Five-Year Plan. Once again, it was proclaimed that the closer the country drew to socialism, the more bitter the resistance of its enemies became and therefore the more intense must be the class struggle against them. This was the ultimate debasement of the cardinal principle of Marxism, for no semblance of a social class was involved in the purge; there was only a struggle of the leadership against the bulk of the Party.

zh: 但党内叛国罪的指控，只有与另一进程结合，才能获得充分的效力，而那一进程通向这场大政变。这第二条发展线索，源于第二次革命过程中党的构成的变化。
en: But accusations of treason in the Party would acquire full potency only in conjunction with another process leading to the great coup d’état. This second line of development derives from changes in the Party’s makeup in the course of the Second Revolution.

zh: 斯大林发动攻势时，党有略多于一百万党员，其中大多数受到充分的思想灌输并忠于总路线。然而在1930至1933年间，党员人数增长了一倍多，新党员绝大多数来自工人阶级和较贫困的农民——这是自战时共产主义以来最迅速、最平民化的扩张。而且，如同战时共产主义时期一样，这些新党员审查不严、灌输仓促，只是松散地融入党的层级结构。此外，党的作用扩张使这些结构本身被拉到极限。在刚刚被征服的农村和新建成的工业中心，必须建立一整套新的党组织网络。此外，党的干部此时必须不止是政治鼓动员和管理者：既然党的主要职责已变成经济，他们就必须具备技术能力，无论是工业还是农业方面的，而不仅仅是红色资历。而尽管在文化战线上做出了巨大努力，新培养的红色专家仍然不够多。甚至不能指望所有新党员都足够正统，因为培养列宁主义者也需要时间。
en: Stalin had begun his Offensive with a Party of slightly more than one million members, most of whom were well indoctrinated and committed to the General Line. Between 1930 and 1933, however, the Party more than doubled in number, with the overwhelming majority of the new recruits coming from the working class and the poorer peasantry—the most rapid and plebeian expansion since War Communism. And, as under War Communism, these recruits were poorly screened, hastily indoctrinated, and only loosely integrated into the Party’s hierarchical structures. The structures themselves, moreover, were strained to the limit by the expansion of the Party’s role. A whole new Party network had to be created in the recently conquered countryside and in the newly built industrial centers. In addition, Party men now had to be more than political agitators and administrators: Since the Party’s main responsibility had become the economy, they had to have technical competence, whether for industry or agriculture, not just Red credentials. And, despite a great effort on the cultural front, not enough new Red specialists had as yet been trained. Nor could all of the new members even be counted on to be adequately orthodox, for forming Leninists also took time.

zh: 此外，1930—1933年间整个社会近乎混乱的状态，使这个扩大了的党承受巨大压力。因为尽管政权力求塑造一种铁板一块的秩序，它的自上而下的革命实际上创造了一个后来被苏联小说家瓦西里·格罗斯曼描述为
的世界。
作为回应，斯大林在1931年的“六点讲话”中试图动员党反对“劳动力的流动”，即计划剧变引发的巨量人口迁移。但党本身也是流动的，因为动荡社会的一些浮渣已渗入其队伍。因此到1933年，斯大林面临干部训练不足、可靠性不高的严重问题，而这个问题位于制度的核心——即在党自身内部。
en: This expanded Party, moreover, was put under great strain by the near-chaos that reigned in society as a whole during 1930-1933. For although the regime sought to fashion a monolithic order, its revolution from above had in fact created a society later described by the Soviet novelist Vasilii Grossman as a world that was

In answer, Stalin in his “six points speech” in 1931 sought to mobilize the Party against the “fluidity of labor,” or the vast migrations of the population set off by the upheaval of the Plan. But the Party, too, was fluid, for some of the flotsam of a society in upheaval had infiltrated its ranks. Thus by 1933 Stalin had an acute problem of ill-trained and unreliable cadres on his hands, and this problem lay at the heart of the system—within the Party itself.

zh: 他的回应是一场清洗，一次对党的“净化”，类似于内战结束时发生的情况。1933年，约四十万名不称职、缺乏积极性和“阶级异己”分子被开除。

但党的机器似乎仍不够可靠，于是1935年对党证的“核查”又清除了近二十万名党员；次年，通过“换发”党证又淘汰了差不多同样数目。因此到1936年底——也就是说，在深度清洗真正开始之前——党员人数已降至仅145万，这意味着四年内减少了75万。而在1937年，即深度清洗的第一年，又有50万党员从党的名册上消失。然而这一次，他们不只是被开除；他们多半被枪决或送进古拉格。尽管如此，有一种逻辑把作为净化的清洗和作为放血的清洗联系起来，这一连续性来自更新干部、用顺从可靠的成员充实党的冲动。简言之，斯大林追求的是理想的等级制军队，那台由听话齿轮组成的机器——他在同一时期正是这样说的。
en: His response was a purge, a “cleansing” of the Party similar to what occurred at the end of the Civil War. In 1933 some 400,000 of the incompetent, the unmotivated, and the “class-alien” were expelled.

But the Party machine still did not seem adequately reliable, so in 1935 a “verification” of Party documents eliminated nearly 200,000 more members; and the next year a similar number was weeded out through an “exchange” of Party documents. Thus by the end of 1936—that is, before the purge-in-depth had really begun—Party membership was down to only 1,450,000, which signified a drop of 750,000 in four years. And in 1937, the first year of the purge-in-depth, 500,000 more members disappeared from the Party’s books. This time, however, they were not simply expelled; they were more often than not shot or sent to the Gulag. Nonetheless, there was a logic that linked the purge as cleansing and the purge as bloodletting, and this continuity was provided by a drive to renew cadres and to staff the Party with submissively reliable members. In short, Stalin was striving for the ideal hierarchical army, that machine of obedient cogs of which he spoke in these same years.

zh: 斯大林非常清楚他能搞成这场政变，因为正如一位讽刺者所说，他每年有50万个新职位可以分配。这正是他1937年清洗掉的党员人数；而到1938年底，已有45万新人取代了他们的位置，这是自1932年以来党员人数的首次增长。在战前接下来的两个完整年份里，每年又增加约50万，因此自1937年血洗这道大分水岭以来，新党员总数达到150万。简言之，考虑到一些新人也被清洗，战争爆发时党员中有一半以上是清洗后招募的。
en: Stalin knew very well he could get away with this coup, for, as one cynic put it, he had 500,000 new jobs to give away each year. This is the number of members he purged in 1937, and by the end of 1938, 450,000 new men had taken their place in the first increase of Party membership since 1932. And in each of the next two full years before the war, some 500,000 more were added, for a total of 1,500,000 new members since the great divide of the blood purge, 1937. In short, given the fact that some of the new men were also purged, more than half of the Party membership at the outbreak of war had been recruited after the purge.

zh: 这些新人三十来岁，是三十年代第二次革命的产物，可以说是斯大林手下向上流动的雅皮士。他们几乎全都是第一个计划期间创办的某所技术或工程学校的毕业生——冶金是最受青睐的领域。
然而，随着斯大林日益意识到“人是最宝贵资本”的极端重要性，这些院校在三十年代中期变得越来越专业化。首先，“民主的”阶级出身不再是进入高等教育的标准；作为权宜之计，资产阶级专家再次被接纳到技术岗位。然后，随着技术学校有能力大规模培养真正称职的干部，这些新专家接管了管理指挥权，并在1938年开始的入党潮中被吸收入党。武装部队的军官团也通过类似的过程得到更新，那过程与补充工业管理干部的过程相同。
en: These new men were “thirty-something” products of the Second Revolution of the thirties, Stalin’s upwardly mobile yuppies, so to speak. Almost all of them were graduates of one or another technical or engineering school created during the first Plan—metallurgy was the favored field.

Yet these institutions were made increasingly professional in the mid-thirties as Stalin became more conscious of the crucial importance of “man as the most precious capital.” First, “democratic” class origin ceased to be a criterion for admission to higher education, and, as a stopgap, bourgeois specialists were once again welcome in technical jobs. Then, as the technical schools became capable of large-scale production of genuinely competent cadres, these new specialists assumed managerial command and were taken into the Party in the upsurge of enrollment that began in 1938. The officer corps of the armed forces was rejuvenated by a process similar to the one that replenished the managerial corps of industry.

zh: 因此，清洗给了斯大林一个主要由大攻势之后形成的人组成的党；这些人是新社会主义制度、其机构及其文化的产物。尽管在政变开始时无疑没有总体计划——正如1929年经济革命也没有一样——但到1937年初，斯大林及其人马显然有意取得他们事实上取得的那些大规模后果。而且，这些结果与同一时期达到顶点的文化国有化的总体化趋势相当一致。在这个语境中看，清洗是三十年代后半期苏联生活一切方面
）、即被纳入统一路线这一过程的一部分。
en: Thus the purges gave Stalin a Party composed for the most part of people who had been formed after the Great Offensive; these people were products of the new socialist system, of its institutions and its culture. Although there was doubtless no master plan at the beginning of the coup—just as there was none in 1929 for the economic revolution—by early 1937 Stalin and his men clearly intended the sweeping results they in fact achieved. These results, moreover, are quite consonant with the totalizing thrust of the nationalization of culture that culminated at the same time. Seen in this context, the purges are a part of the process of
, the bringing into line, of all aspects of Soviet life in the second half of the thirties.

zh: 正是这种干部更换，以及随之而来的用新党取代旧党，是这场大政变的核心。政变的关键时刻是1937年，即党员人数降至最低点的那一年。此时，对党员名册的“净化”突然变成了对反党“敌人”的消灭。因此，那一年将永远作为国家精英记忆中近乎传奇的恐怖时期留在记忆里，并标志着斯大林主义和苏联历史上的大分水岭。
en: It is this exchange of cadres, and the concomitant replacement of the old Party by a new one, that is the heart of the great coup d’état. The coup’s pivotal moment was 1937, the year in which Party membership reached its nadir. At this point the “cleansing” of Party lists suddenly turned into an annihilation of anti-Party “enemies.” That year would therefore remain ever after a time of legendary horror for the nation’s elite, and mark the great divide in Stalinist and Soviet history.

zh: 毫无疑问，这场党的更新实际上就是政变的中心目的。真正的问题是：斯大林为什么觉得自己需要一场政变？他通过哪些步骤实施？为什么它直到1936年才开始，即在整个行动的借口——基洛夫遇刺——之后两年？
en: There is little doubt that this renovation of the Party was in fact the central purpose of the coup. The real questions are: Why did Stalin feel he needed a coup? By what steps did he carry it out? And why did it begin only in 1936, two years after the pretext for the whole operation—Kirov’s assassination?

zh: 延迟的部分原因，无疑是斯大林在政治局和中央委员会中继续遇到对他镇压一切旧反对派和新动摇者这一意愿的抵抗，而这种抵抗只会增加他的愤怒，也增加他最终按自己意愿行事的决心。也很可能，奥尔忠尼启则、古比雪夫等人接过了基洛夫早先的角色，力主温和。至少，从斯大林在他们最后日子里对他们众所周知的敌意，以及从后来有文献记载的帕维尔·波斯蒂舍夫的案例来看，这是一个合理的推断——波斯蒂舍夫1937年在中央委员会中为一名可能被清洗的受害者与斯大林公开冲突。
en: A part of the reason for the delay was that Stalin no doubt continued to encounter resistance in the Politburo and the Central Committee to his desire to crush all old oppositionists and new waverers, and this resistance could only have increased his anger as well as his determination to have his way eventually. It is also quite possible that Ordzhonikidze, Kuibyshev, and others had taken up the earlier role of Kirov in urging moderation. At least this is a reasonable inference from Stalin’s known hostility toward them during their last days, as well as from the later, and documented, case of Pavel Postyshev, who in 1937 openly clashed with Stalin in the Central Committee regarding a prospective purge victim.

zh: 斯大林的怒火一定更大，因为这些反对不是来自旧反对派，而是来自久经考验的忠实的斯大林派。与多伊彻等人的论点相反，斯大林不可能很担心旧左派和右派反对派联合起来在危机中取代他。
这些人物在党内已没有足够的基础采取这样的行动。如果他的权力要受到任何威胁，那只能来自那些希望换掉一个失败的老板、但保留其制度的斯大林派——他们曾帮助建立这个制度，并在其中有支持和政治权威来领导。旧反对派只在公审中显眼，而这一情况掩盖了一个更重要的事实：一旦斯大林终于得到他的清洗，其受害者绝大多数都是他自己的人。
en: Stalin’s fury must have been all the greater since these objections came not from old oppositionists but from good Stalinists of long standing. Contrary to what Deutscher and others have argued, Stalin could not have been very concerned about the prospect of a coalition of the old Left and Right oppositions replacing him in a crisis.

These figures no longer had an adequate base in the Party for such action. If there were to be any threat to his power it could only come from Stalinists who wished to replace a failing Boss but keep his system, which they had helped to build and in which they had the support and political authority to lead. The old oppositionists were prominent only in the show trials, and this circumstance has obscured the much more important fact that, once Stalin at last got his purge, its victims were overwhelmingly his own men.

zh: 但斯大林对党的不满，还因第三个问题而加剧，这个问题在1936年急剧恶化。因为这一年，长期被政权近乎偏执地关注的国际形势终于真正变得危险。
到1934年，此前一直被苏联人贬为德国科尔尼洛夫的希特勒已在国内巩固权力；1936年，他恢复普遍兵役制并重新占领莱茵兰。与此同时，日本从满洲向中国本部推进，同时沿阿穆尔河试探苏联实力。从此以后，苏联不得不认真对待近期爆发战争的可能性。而战争，尤其是如果战事不利，极容易引发致命的国内危机，每个苏联公民都从1914—1917年的经历中记得这一点。
en: But Stalin’s frustration with the Party was aggravated by still a third problem that took a sharp turn for the worse in 1936. For this was the year when the international situation, so long an object of quasi-paranoid concern to the regime, at last became genuinely dangerous.

By 1934 Hitler, whom the Soviets had until then discounted as a German Kornilov, had consolidated his power internally; in 1936 he reintroduced universal military service and reoccupied the Rhineland. At the same time, Japan advanced from Manchuria into China proper, while she simultaneously tested Soviet strength along the Amur River. From this time onward, the Soviet Union had to take seriously the possibility of war in the near future. And war, especially if it went badly, could only too easily trigger a fatal domestic crisis, as every Soviet citizen remembered from the experience of 1914-1917.

children: 〔译注〕德国恢复征兵制的法令颁于1935年3月16日；德军进入莱茵兰是1936年。本书在此将两事并列于1936年。
〔译注〕德国恢复征兵制的法令颁于1935年3月16日；德军进入莱茵兰是1936年。本书在此将两事并列于1936年。

zh: 但1936年还给苏联带来一种新的外部危险：国际舞台因法西斯主义问题而突然两极分化，而俄国作为一个意识形态大国，自动被卷入这场旋涡的中心。在法国，1934年右翼对共和国的攻击促成了自由派、社会主义者和共产党人反对法西斯主义的第一个人民阵线。次年，人民阵线方针成为共产国际的政策，但更多是为了保卫苏维埃国家抵御希特勒，而不是促进西方的革命。然而在1936年，至少从苏联的角度看，人民阵线现象失控了。在法国，人民阵线在5月选举中获胜，引发6月一波占厂罢工（当时是新奇现象），一时看来带有起义性质。次月，西班牙人民阵线遭到佛朗哥将军的叛乱；这开启了一场为期三年的内战，佛朗哥得到德国和意大利的援助。法国事件使托洛茨基得以谈论一场新革命，西班牙事件则给托洛茨基分子和其他激进左派提供了一场实际的革命战争。
第一次世界大战释放、又在二十年代初被扑灭的激进浪潮，此时似乎重新涌起；不断革命看来再次前进，而这一次是针对“资本主义最高形式”的新变种——法西斯主义。
en: But 1936 also brought the Soviet Union a new kind of foreign danger: The international scene suddenly polarized over the issue of fascism, and Russia as an ideological power was automatically thrust into the middle of this maelstrom. In France a Right-wing attack on the republic in 1934 had produced the first Popular Front of liberals, socialists, and Communists against fascism. The next year the formula of the Popular Front became the policy of the Comintern, but more to defend the Soviet state against Hitler than to promote revolution in the West. In 1936, however, the Popular Front phenomenon got out of hand, at least from the Soviets’ point of view. In France a Popular Front victory in the May elections triggered in June a wave of sitdown strikes (at the time a novel phenomenon) that for a while appeared insurrectionary. The next month the Spanish Popular Front was confronted by the revolt of General Franco; this began a three-year Civil War in which he was aided by Germany and Italy. The French events made it possible for Trotsky to speak of a new revolution, and the Spanish events presented Trotskyites and other militant Leftists with an actual revolutionary war.

The radical surge unleashed by the First World War and broken in the early twenties now seemed to resume; permanent revolution appeared once again to be on the march, and this time against a new mutant of the “highest form of capitalism”—fascism.

zh: 这一新力量的出现，对苏联在世界上的地位产生了重大而持久的影响。此后，世界上第一个工人国家可以把自己呈现为——也常被他人视为——法西斯主义的对立面，因而是世界上唯一坚定不移的反法西斯力量。对一般左派来说，法西斯主义代表绝对的恶，因此共产主义被塑造成善的不可或缺的守护者。于是，从三十年代中期起，“不把左派当敌人”的旧原则被赋予新的、更激进的含义。自由派似乎被历史召唤去奉行危险的政策：与反自由主义的左派结盟，对抗新的极右。
en: The emergence of this new force had a major and enduring impact on the Soviet Union’s position in the world.
